key_sections: Section I: Loss of or Damage to the Vehicle Insured
Schedule of Depreciation for Fixing IDV of the Vehicle
Section II: Liability to Third Parties
available_fields: Policy Type (Two-Wheeler Package Policy – 5 years)
Insurer Name (The Oriental Insurance Company Limited)
Unique Identification Number (UIN: IRDAN556RP0004V01201819)
Basis of Contract (Proposal and Declaration)
Vehicle Types Covered (Motor cycle/scooter/auto cycle or any other motorized two-wheeled vehicle)

Section I Coverage (Perils: fire, explosion, self-ignition, lightning, burglary, housebreaking, theft, riot, strike, earthquake, flood, typhoon, hurricane, storm, tempest, inundation, cyclone, hailstorm, frost, accidental external means, malicious act, terrorist activity, transit by road/rail/inland-waterway/lift/elevator/air, landslide, rockslide)
Depreciation Rates for Parts Replaced (Rubber/Nylon/Plastic parts, tyres, tubes, batteries: 50%, Fiber glass components: 30%, Glass parts: Nil)
Depreciation Schedule for Other Parts (Age-based: 6 months, 1 year, 2 years, 3 years, 4 years, 5 years)
Depreciation for Painting (50% on material cost; material component considered as 25% of total painting charges)

Exclusions (Consequential loss, wear and tear, mechanical/electrical breakdown, damage to tyres/tubes unless vehicle damaged simultaneously, loss of accessories unless vehicle stolen, accidents under influence of intoxicants)
Cost of Protection and Removal (Up to Rs. 300 per accident)
Repair Authorization Conditions (Estimated cost ≤ Rs. 150, detailed estimate required, insurer’s consent for necessity and reasonableness)
Insured's Declared Value (IDV) Definition and Purpose
IDV Calculation Basis (Manufacturer's listed selling price adjusted for depreciation)
Schedule of Depreciation for IDV (Age-based: 6 months, 1 year, 2 years, 3 years, 4 years, 5 years)
Market Value Treatment for IDV (No further depreciation for TL/CTL claims)
Constructive Total Loss (CTL) Definition (Aggregate cost of retrieval/repair exceeds 75% of IDV)
Section II Coverage (Third-party liability: death/bodily injury, property damage)
Exclusions for Third-Party Liability (Occupants carried for hire/reward, employees in course of employment, property belonging to/trusted/custodied by insured)
Geographical Limits for Liability (Within carriageway/thoroughfare for loading/unloading)
Costs and Expenses Coverage (With insurer’s written consent)
Driver Indemnity (Drivers with insured’s permission, subject to policy terms)
Personal Representative Indemnity (In case of death of insured person)
summary: This document is the policy wordings for a 5-year Two-Wheeler Package Policy issued by The Oriental Insurance Company Limited. It outlines the terms, conditions, and coverage details for loss or damage to the insured two-wheeler vehicle (Section I) and third-party liability (Section II). Key elements include covered perils, depreciation rates for parts and IDV, exclusions, repair conditions, IDV calculation methodology, and third-party liability limits. The document also specifies the basis of the contract, definitions, and general provisions applicable to the policy.
